integration_grid._note: Grid for DFT numerical integration. DefGrid2 is default. The legacy Grid1-7/FinalGridN keywords were REMOVED in ORCA 6 (it rejects them as unrecognized) — use DefGrid1-3.

relativistic_options._note: Relativistic Hamiltonians (require matching basis set). To disable, simply omit — ORCA has no NoZORA/NoDKH '!'-line keywords.

frozen_core_options._note: Frozen core for post-HF methods. The FC_ELECTRONS/FC_NONE/FC_EWIN selectors live in %method, not on the '!' line (ORCA rejects them there).

external_methods._note: External program / interface keywords. (ONIOM is set up via its own block, not a bare '!'-line keyword.)
